items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Ted Easton showed up and asked me to this album for him.

ctx.x: I supposed that performance must've led to you recording in Holland two years later.
Yeah. Well, I was on tour with The World's Greatest Jazz Band in that year. And we played Amsterdam, and Ted Easton showed up and asked me to this album for him.

And, of course, I had to stay over to do the album. And that morning I looked and the bus was pulling off. The band was going to the next gig. And it was kind of a lonely feeling, you know, being in Amsterdam, Holland by yourself. And I didn't know that much about Ted Easton. And on top of that, he was late showing. Then I really got jittery.
